title: Prof Margaret Morse Lens eval
objective: Preserve the embodied, artistic, relational, and media-aware intelligence that explains why Jamie's systems differ from conventional administration, while keeping the hiring path clear and public-safe.
decision: Does the portfolio retain a legible threshold where Jamie's artistic, civic, technical, and social practices remain connected?

scoreScale.1: The portfolio erases the artistic and relational practice or turns it into unsupported mystique.
scoreScale.2: Artistic history appears as biography or decoration but does not explain Jamie's present method.
scoreScale.3: The connection is inferable, but operational utility still flattens embodied inquiry, participation, hospitality, attention, or place.
scoreScale.4: A first-pass reader can see how embodied artistic inquiry informs Jamie's humane systems practice without losing hiring clarity.
scoreScale.5: The connection is memorable and exact: artistic, civic, technical, and social practices illuminate one another while evidence, consent, and reader effort remain well governed.

deterministicChecks.description: The portfolio preserves a public-safe artistic-systems threshold and the knowledge bank records its evidence and limits.
The artistic-method framing remains no stronger than its source basis.
Narrative evaluations and correspondence do not expose student identifiers, private contact data, or raw private records.
The Margaret Morse Lens revision passes the complete production preflight.

criteria.name: Prof Margaret Morse Lens
criteria.question: Can a reader see that Jamie's operating practice grows from embodied inquiry, attention, hospitality, participation, media awareness, and the art/life continuum, rather than reading him only as an efficiency-producing administrator?
criteria.passDefinition: The About page preserves one concise threshold connecting artistic, civic, technical, and social practice; selected projects show people inhabiting and shaping systems; the site acknowledges value beyond organizational efficiency; and the source layer preserves media archaeology, performative inquiry, collaboration, consent, and public-access boundaries without turning private evaluations into testimonials.
evidenceToInspect: NYC Artist Coalition / FairRentNYC case study
Open House source and claim records
criteria.repairPolicy: Repair the smallest public threshold that restores continuity. Prefer a precise present-method statement over a retrospective survey; keep detailed history and source limits in the knowledge bank.
criteria.antiGaming: Do not pass by adding vague creativity language, publishing private correspondence, using praise as proof of outcomes, romanticizing precarity, erasing collaborators, or forcing every project to perform every artistic dimension.
